args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production (unhealthy, error rate 18%) in us-east, us-west and eu-west. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before the production release. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 regression and why it was promoted.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Problem:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it, the health checks pass and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure and the rollback, and lists follow-up work.
- **Worth noting:** The test build of v2.3.1 (v2.3.1-rc) was also failing in staging before v2.3.1 was released to production. I noted this in the incident so the team can look at why it was released anyway.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
